title: HealthSmart Essential Oil Diffuser 500 mL White

comparisons.notes: HealthSmart 500mL Essential Oil Diffuser, 500 mL, White. Sold and shipped by DermiLA Market LLC, free shipping.
Manufacturer page for model 40-500-190, white, 500 mL tank, 1/3/6 hr timer and auto shut-off. In stock.

writeup: The HealthSmart 500 mL essential oil diffuser in white (model 40-500-190) is $7.57 new at Woot, versus $19.95 at Walmart and $33.99 on HealthSmart's own site. It doubles as a cool-mist humidifier with seven LED colors, a 1, 3 or 6 hour timer, and auto shut-off when the tank runs dry. Woot limits it to 3 per order and stock looked low.
